title: Help & Documentation
description: Everything you need to manage the Afrochow platform

faqs.question: How do I approve a vendor?
faqs.answer: Go to Vendors → find the vendor row → click Verify. The vendor will immediately appear as verified and can start receiving orders.

faqs.question: What's the difference between Verify and Activate?
faqs.answer: Verify confirms the vendor's business documents are legitimate. Activate/Suspend controls whether the vendor can receive new orders. A vendor can be verified but still suspended.

faqs.question: Can I undo a verification?
faqs.answer: Yes, click Revoke on any verified vendor to remove their verified status without deleting their account.

faqs.question: Who can change user roles?
faqs.answer: Only SUPERADMIN accounts can change roles or delete users. Regular ADMIN accounts can activate/suspend non-admin users.

faqs.question: Can I delete a SUPERADMIN?
faqs.answer: No. SUPERADMIN accounts are fully protected, they cannot be modified, suspended, or deleted through the dashboard.

faqs.question: How do I promote an admin to SUPERADMIN?
faqs.answer: On the Users page, find an ADMIN-role user and click Promote (only visible to SUPERADMIN accounts). This calls /superadmin/users/{id}/promote.

faqs.question: What order statuses are there?
faqs.answer: PENDING → CONFIRMED → PREPARING → READY → DELIVERING → DELIVERED. Orders can also be CANCELLED at any stage.

faqs.question: Can admins cancel orders?
faqs.answer: Order status management is handled by vendors and the delivery system. Admin order view is read-only for monitoring.

faqs.question: What's the difference between Hide and Delete?
faqs.answer: Hide removes the review from public view but keeps it in the system, so it can be restored. Delete permanently removes it.

faqs.question: Can vendors see hidden reviews?
faqs.answer: No. Hidden reviews are only visible in the admin dashboard under the Hidden filter.

faqs.question: How do I create a promo code?
faqs.answer: Go to Promotions → New Promotion → fill in the code, discount %, and optional expiry/usage limit.

faqs.question: Can I update an active promotion?
faqs.answer: Yes, click Edit on any promotion to update its details. Changes take effect immediately.

faqs.question: What does Deactivate do?
faqs.answer: Deactivating a promotion prevents it from being used at checkout. It does not delete historical usage data.

faqs.question: What does the Platform Overview show?
faqs.answer: Total revenue, order counts, active vendors, average order value, and new user signups over time.

faqs.question: How often is analytics data updated?
faqs.answer: Analytics are computed in real time from the database. Data is current as of when you load the page.

faqs.question: Who receives a broadcast?
faqs.answer: Choose All Users, Customers only, Vendors only, or Admins only before sending. Broadcasts cannot be undone.

faqs.question: What can ADMIN do vs SUPERADMIN?
faqs.answer: ADMIN: verify/suspend vendors, activate/suspend customers & vendors, moderate reviews, manage promotions, view analytics. SUPERADMIN: everything ADMIN can do, plus change user roles, delete users, promote/demote admins.

faqs.question: Why am I getting "You don't have permission"?
faqs.answer: Some backend controllers still use @PreAuthorize("hasRole('ADMIN')") which blocks SUPERADMIN. The fix is to update those to @PreAuthorize("hasAnyRole('ADMIN', 'SUPERADMIN')").
